steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cook corn according to package directions. Drain; transfer to a large bowl.
Stir cream cheese, melted butter, garlic, sugar, parsley, and salt into corn until well combined; transfer to a casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned on top, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Yum-Yum Corn
raw_recipe.description: The easy yum-yum corn recipe features corn baked with butter, cream cheese, parsley, garlic, and a touch of sugar. Just one taste and everyone says yum.
raw_recipe.name: Yum-Yum Corn

review.reviewBody: I found this recipe last year for a friend of mine who was looking for a "corn" recipe for thanksgiving well she raved about how everyone loved it and i brought it for christmas..well everyone her family adn mine ALL loved it the people who didn't try it were upset because by the time everyone was raving about it it was all gone!!! neither of us used glarlic cloves though, we used 1TBSP of garlic powder this makes it not so strong a taste...wonderful had to come back to check cause im making it for thx this year!!

I’ve been making a variation of this for the last few years. I’ve done both stove top only and crock pot. I haven’t found a need to drain the water after cooking the corn as it all incorporates nicely. I love to step things up and add a small can of drained, chopped jalapeños and some crispy bacon. It’s so good that I’m asked to make it for every gathering! Thanks for the recipe and enjoy!

My guests LOVED this! Followed recipe exactly, threw it in the slow cooker on low so I could give attention to my other dishes and everyone said they liked it! Used fresh corn - all the difference in the world!

This has become a holiday staple for my family. I usually add extra garlic...and sprinkle breadcrumbs and butter on the top before baking. (You know a recipe is good when it doesn't even make it into the oven before several spoonfuls are missing!)

I’m sure this would have been good following the recipe but had to use what I had on hand… I used chive and onion cream cheese, added pepper and sautéed onions that I was making for another recipe from this site… Lastly made this corn using one baking dish from start to finish, this recipe is a keeper ❤️

Couldn’t see any reason to cook the corn, since it was going to bake for 30 mins. I just let the corn thaw, mixed everything together, and into the oven. I used a bag of Birds Eye® baby gold and white corn and fresh parsley instead of dry. It was a bit of an indulgence for a side dish, but there were no complaints, and there were no leftovers!

Yum Yum Corn is a good name for this recipe because that is what my family said after their first taste. We were snowed in for about a week and eating what I had in my pantry. I needed to find a new way to serve corn. I had every thing on hand except parsley and frozen corn. I left the parsley out, and used 2 cans of drained whole kernel corn.. Delicious results! Yum!
This is one of my daughter's favorites. I cut back a little on the cream cheese and I never bake it. Just cook the corn, drain, add the other ingredients, stir and serve. Delicious!

Great recipe, I have made this every Thanksgiving and Christmas since finding it on this site. Started out making as originally written then spiced it up a bit by using jalapeno cream cheese instead of regular.

I love this recipe... I make it every Thanksgiving and Christmas, it's so popular I have to double the recipie. The only change I make is, I use diced garlic and I add a can of diced green chilles! It's amazing!
This year I also substituted raw coconut sugar instead of white sugar.

I make a very similar recipe and add cooked, crumbled bacon and sliced green onions. It is so good and always draws lots of compliments and recipe requests!! But just the plain recipe is super good, too.....
My guests loved it! I will make it again.
Absolutely delicious! I added a can of Mexican corn to add a little more spice. Definitely a keeper!
This is my new favorite way to make corn! So easy and so good!
It was delicious! My husband said it was definitely a keeper and friends have requested the recipe.
This is a 'good'un as written. Cooking for two, so adjusted to 5 servings. Gone in a flash.. Now --got some tweaks to try next,,

Easy delicious side dish! Made this exactly by recipe.

Made this for a potluck, and nothing was left! I used canned corn, as the store was out of frozen. Just heated it till very hot ( do not boil) ,drain, put back into the warm pot, then fold in all the ingredients till well blended, place in casserole dish and bake! This dish is a mark up from serving just regular corn and goes great with any beef or even chicken or thanksgiving turkey! Yum! Yum!

Wow. We love this recipe. I doubled the recipe, when we finished that night. My partner asked that I serve it again the next. I just had to make the meal be complimentary to this corn, he added. LOL. All 4 of us enjoyed this, very much. Thanks for the share!
